Follow up a transaction at a ministry or directorate.

We refer to our client {client} and to transaction {matter_number} before your directorate.
We kindly ask you to complete the necessary procedure and to inform us of the result, or of any document still required.
Thank you for your cooperation.
A formal notice served through the notary, including the revocation of an agent.

The notifying party: {client}, represented by its agent, lawyer {responsible}.
The notified party: {opponent}.
Subject of the notice: ...
The notifying party hereby calls on you to ... within ... days of being served with this notice. Otherwise it will take every legal measure available to it, and you will bear the fees, costs and lawyer's fees.
This notice was issued for your information and action.
Any request to a body, a company or a court office.

On behalf of our client {client}, we kindly ask you to ...
The supporting documents are attached.
Tell the client where their matter stands and what comes next.

Dear {client},
We write to update you on matter {matter_number} ({matter}).
Where it stands: ...
What happens next: ...
For any question, please contact {responsible}.
Extension of a letter of guarantee
To the bank, before the letter of guarantee expires.

We ask you to extend letter of guarantee number {guarantee_number}, for {guarantee_amount}, issued in favour of {beneficiary} and expiring on {guarantee_expiry}, for a further ... months.
Please send us confirmation of the extension.
Release of a letter of guarantee
To the beneficiary, once the secured obligations are fulfilled.

The obligations secured by letter of guarantee number {guarantee_number}, issued by {bank} for {guarantee_amount}, have been fulfilled.
We ask you to return the original letter of guarantee to us, or to write to the bank to release it.
